'''{{PAGENAME}}''' are a late-game resource, used for crafting various advanced items and work-stations. Their creation is limited to the [[furnace III]], though they can be bought from (and sold to) the [[Krezvold|blacksmith]], once his tier-3 stock is unlocked.
